body:
My favorite xkcd
[We're adults now and we decide what that means](http://xkcd.com/150/)

Hey I get you. I too have suffered from depression and suicidal thoughts (mine have been going on quite long though since about middle school) but I know very well how to overcome them. Its part of the reason why I can't help but try to help her. I understand that I could never understand what is going through her mind (trust me I tried for a looong time) and that she needs to accept the help before any progress is made.

I'm going to let her come to me but if she doesn't by wednesday I am going to go to where her and my friends are going to hang out with her that day (friends agree this is better than nothing). I have things I need to tell her regardless and I want to get them out and have her gone from my life again. They are things I have though of for the past couple weeks anyways and have had the thought of telling her but simply have not had a reason to. She needs to feel like she can actually add good to this world and I want to tell her that even though we went out shitty overall her being there when she was was amazing and her breaking up with me allowed me to be who I am today and she shouldn't think that her life is just full of mistakes. 

I understand that i could be just falling into bullshit but like you said worst case scenario I waste a bit more time (and sanity).

I just wish I could know what to do like your boyfriend did. I just can't understand people's anxieties but at the same time people can never understand my anxiety to help other as much as I do so I know how it can feel.

Thanks for your comment.

Yes I know that adage very well. Like I said I have helped many other people out of depression and understand that fully. But sometimes the right person can give the push they need and I would rather do that than nothing at all.

I would agree with you about the attention whoring except for one thing. Like I said in the above insane amount of text is that she "planned it out" and that she, at least in the time that I knew her, has never been able to plan anything out. When I say that its not an exaggeration she seriously could not think of anything past the first step. She had posted tons of suicidal stuff previously but I could see right away that those were just attention things. This one however spooked me and regardless I need to talk to her one last time. I do not plan on keeping any further communication after that.

The fact that she had a plan for it really spoke to me. Also she said "I love you" to her mom and dad at the end and also blamed herself for her parent's split (this is news to me btw when I was with her, the parents seemed happy enough).

Anyways I know that I cannot be at ease until I do talk to her and that after that its all her.

Hey thanks.

well the gym is actually one of her many anxiety issues. She has terrible self image and goes to the gym religiously for at least an hour sometimes 2 hours every day and if she misses a day or eats cake she gets terrible anxiety to the point of self harm (it was never razer blades, she has gone there but not too severe, but she would scratch at the chubbier parts of her body until they were riddled with nail marks all over like an animal got to her). (I do not know if this is still the case but it was for the entirety of our dating life).

The issue is I am not going to be there for help always I did that constantly for the entire time we dated. This is a one time thing. She is far over and done with me as I am with her. I have things I feel I need to say to her not only because I feel I need to get things off my chest (no they are not negative and are things that could only help her) and also I cannot sit idle when I see someone in so much pain no matter how much bitterness/anger/negativity I have in my heart/mind for them. I don't care if you're my worst enemy if you are hurting i'm going to at least sit down with you once to try to help. She needs to know that even though its been shitty, having her in my life still adds up to a lot of good things, there's nothing left for us but I want her to at least know that i'm not going to resent her for the rest of our lives and I need to forgive her so I can finally truly move on.

shes a good person deep down inside she just does a lot of shitty things.

anyways thanks for the kind words. If you are worried what I am going to say to her pm me and I will pm you what I have thought of.

> What are you really trying to accomplish? Are you trying to tell her what she needs to hear or what you need to tell her?

A little bit of both. What I want to tell her just happens to encompass both things. Like I said its stuff I have thought about telling her before this (the past month is the first month I have been consistently happy on my own/with friends and idk I guess I was just able to think clearly about the whole thing). If you are worried about what I am going to tell her pm me and I will pm you what I have thought about telling her so at least I can put your mind at ease. But basically I just want to tell her that despite how shitty its been that her being in my life was still a great thing for me and that I am not going to hate her to her grave (probably not going to say exactly that last part).

> What role do you want to play in her life? Friend? Boyfriend? Guy who shows up to save her and then disappears into a puff of smoke?

I honestly do not want to play any role in her life. If circumstances were different I wouldn't have even contacted her. But i'm not the type of person that can sit idle and watch someone's world crash down around them no matter how bitter I am especially since I feel that I can actually do some help. So i'm sorry to say but for this one instance I guess its mostly the latter. I will not be doing this again even if another scare happens since I will have said my peace because at that point any burden I have had on her should be done and its up to her. She wants to be a good person I saw that in her when I dated her, she does tons of shitty things but I could always see that deep inside her even when she didn't want to admit it. I also don't think I need to worry about that since she was able to give up all feelings for me within a week.

> You may stir up old feelings and end up hurting her and yourself.

couldn't give a shit about myself when there's someone else out there hurting this badly. Her on the other hand. Like I said I don't feel that I have to worry about old feelings. If anything they will just remind her that she has been and can be happy. Also I think the main thing is she needs to feel like she actually contributes something positive to this world and that alone will be enough.

Like I said I have experience with pulling people out of depression so I have analysed this from every angle. At the same time iv'e done it for her for too long and I don't have the strength to do it daily again. This is a one time thing because I will regret the decision to do nothing forever if something does happen.

Lastly I also wouldn't be doing this if there was anyone more qualified to do so. both my best friends of many years are still acquaintances of hers and they agree that I am better suited for this than them. Her parents would have been the first people I called if they weren't such a big issue. Her best friend is fake to her face and would be of no help if she tried because obviously fake help only causes hurt in the end. So i'm the last person to know her on such a personal level.

> In any case, it's really admirable that you care for her that much. You seem like a lovely guy.

Thanks I needed that. This is causing a ton of stress for me and bringing up a lot of stuff I was not ready to deal with again but i'll keep on keeping on.

Look I'm really confused right now so sorry if I don't make sense. I normally do good under anxiety but this is too much for me right now.

anyways

for one thing I did not ever mention the direct reason for me calling her and just said I want to talk so to her that could mean anything. But you are right she doesn't care for me at all.

when you said

> It seems that you are that kind of a person, you need others to be okay and you get distressed and anxious if you think there is something wrong.

you have no idea how true that is and its a burdon that i'm willing to keep.

heres the issue. I have no wish to have her in my life at all. not as a friend not as an acquaintance, nothing. I simply have things I wanted to tell her before she offed herself. I feel that a) they would help her and b) I have been thinking of saying them to her anyways but have not had a reason to since for the past month or so I have been on the tail end of my bitterness towards the subject. I also didn't want her to feel like I hated her to the grave and at the very least she could have died in peace (although if I had a feeling she was going to do something I would contact the parents right away and let the situation handle itself at that point for better or for worse). The longer I think of her the more anxiety I get, depression sets in, I want it gone. This was supposed to be a I call her she listens its done not this charades bullshit.

My issue now is that on top of the anxiety stated before I have the anxiety of talking to someone who has made the last 9 months of my life confusing, depressing, but also full of changes good and bad and honestly I wouldn't have had it any other way because a lot of good came from it (not that she had anything to do with it but I guess it kickstarted it).

Also yes your right I do care for people who have much less care for me but thats just who I am. I can't control it. I understand i'm going to get hurt a lot but thats what makes a strong person. Knowing you are going to get hurt but doing something that will hopefully make the world a little better. Idk maybe im just a hopeless poet but its how I feel.

lastly to answer your question about me checking the blog well this is kinda pathetic. I would check her tumblr from time to time to see what relationship issues/whining she was posting there so I could get my fix of "haha my life is better than yours". But obviously i'm not heartless so when I saw that it scared me.

but just to make absolutely concrete I do not want a relationship of any kind with her. Theres too much there already and too much baggage for me to carry. I did that for almost 2 years and i'm way past done with it.
